oracle-l5r-10700.note: Constructing the Self (Spell, issue #677): its created card now has a published proxy (Minor Illusion, oracle-l5r-11341, a 0F Illusion - Nonhuman - Cavalry - Shugenja Personality whose Chi and Personal Honor are printed "*"), and the two values could be written on the created card as it is made (as The Wind's Champion's Force is, CreatedProxies677.cs). What is missing is its last sentence, "After the next time this game this Spell straightens or leaves play, remove the Illusion from the game": a standing watch that ties one created card to one Spell and fires when that Spell is straightened by anything (the Straighten Phase, an effect) or leaves play by any path. Straighten() and the leaving-play paths have no feature hook, and nothing records which Illusion a Spell made. "This Spell may remain bowed" is the engine's optional straightening (the choose-straighten effect), which exists. Question for Mendon: are the Illusion's Chi and Personal Honor fixed when it is created, or do they follow the Shugenja's as his change (the proxy prints "are equal to the Chi and Personal Honor of the caster")?

oracle-l5r-10612.note: The Tower of Vigilance (Holding, issue #677): its created card now has a published proxy (Tower Guard, oracle-l5r-11345, a 0F/2C/2PH Guard - Samurai Personality), and creating a Personality at the current battlefield until the battle ends is built. The card itself is a Fortification ("Fortifications attach, straightened, to the Province from which they entered play"), and no Fortification is built: a Holding has no province it is attached to, so "If you have any units at this battlefield ... create ... there" has no battlefield to read, and the Holding does not leave play with its Province.

oracle-l5r-10296.note: Kitsune Yuribara (Personality, issue #677): her created card's scan is published (Yuribara's Butterflies, oracle-l5r-10808), but the Butterflies print two traits the engine does not have, so nothing may create them yet. "Other player's Battle actions must target a Butterfly Personality at this battlefield, if legal" is a forced-target rule over every Battle action the other player takes at that battlefield: target legality has bars (TargetBars.cs, TargetOfLastResort.cs) but no rule that makes one card the only legal target while it is one, for single targets, slots and Attacks alike. "After another player's Battle action targets this card: Destroy this card" is a mandatory trait on being targeted; the targeted-by-action window offers optional Reactions only. Yuribara's own Reaction (create the Butterflies after she enters play) is Kitsu Tamao's shape and needs nothing new.

oracle-l5r-10659.note: Daigotsu Kikumura (Personality, issue #677): the two 1F Followers his Invest creates are the published Farmlands Conscripts (oracle-l5r-10004), and Invest 4 is Clay Kshatriya's entering-play window. "If you are a Dragon Clan player, Kikumura's Invest is 2" is a price that depends on the player: a Gold cost rule (GoldCostRule) has no player-Clan condition. The usual split into two abilities that share one use (Moto Hailung's discount) does not work in the entering-play window, where an ability with no target is listed without being validated (MatchQueries.AddReaction): both prices would be offered to every player and the wrong one refused only when used.
